summary: Verified fix for 'niche cards hidden behind sale strip' layout bug on Homepage. Header now uses ResizeObserver-driven spacer height + 16px breathing gap, so niche cards remain fully visible whether the Flat 50% sale strip is ON or OFF. Also re-ran key regressions: admin route auth-guards, admin/orders delivery-type-filter options, and sale-strip toggle behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request selector 'a[href=\"/anti-aging\"]' is ambiguous: HomepageSaleStrip wraps its entire strip in <Link to=\"/anti-aging\">, so that anchor lives INSIDE the header when sale is ON. The niche card (NicheCardSwitcher.js) for anti-aging uses route '/' with data-testid 'niche-card-anti-aging'. For future assertions, use data-testid selectors, not '/anti-aging' href.

Could not verify per-product sale-badge (data-testid='sale-badge-<slug>') because concern/<slug> pages currently have 0 seeded products for the flagship concerns; badge component only renders in ConcernCategoryPage.js. Not a regression of this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout measurements at 430x900 viewport with sale-mode toggled via PUT /api/admin/sale-mode: (Sale ON) header.bottom=169.5px, niche-card-anti-aging.top=191.94px, gap=22.44px. (Sale OFF) header.bottom=109px, niche-card top=131.44px, gap=22.44px. Both >=12px breathing room and non-clipping requirement satisfied. Admin routes /admin/offers, /admin/warehouses, /admin/delivery-men correctly redirect to /admin login when no token. /admin/orders delivery-type-filter renders with options ['all','instant','standard']. Sale-mode reset to enabled=false at end of run. Backend has 30s in-process cache on products endpoint (_get_sale_cfg) — wait ~31s between sale toggles when validating product-side effects.
rca of the issue: Prior code hard-coded the header spacer to h-[102px]/h-[108px]. When the FLAT 50% sale strip was mounted inside <header>, header height grew to ~157–170px but the spacer stayed static, causing the first section (niche cards) to slide up under the fixed header. Fix in Navigation.js uses a headerRef + ResizeObserver to set spacer height = actual header height + 16px, which auto-grows with the sale strip and adds a visible breathing gap.
